# MoxyArt Studio

> AI creative studio in Brooklyn, NY for local businesses (restaurants, shops, and service businesses).

MoxyArt Studio offers AI-built websites, GEO / AI search visibility and local Google presence, an AI receptionist, AI automations and integrations, AI ads and commercials, and AI lead finding.

## Services

- AI-built websites
- GEO / AI search visibility and local Google presence
- AI receptionist
- AI automations and integrations
- AI ads and commercials
- AI lead finding
